_comment: Trust anchor for bin/argon-guardian-relay. guardian_sha is the last argon commit the argon guardian verified before its runner stopped (provenance-guardian last success 2026-11-06T23:33:42Z); the verifier is loaded from that commit, never from the tree being judged. founder_chat_sha256 is read from genesis-guardian-trust.json at that commit. initial_base is where the relay starts when it has no cached verified head. Changing this file is a trust rotation: it lands only through the Greenlane on this repository, whose main is protected server-side, unlike argon's.
